FINDING (medium, correctness): `never_auto` still does not win in deterministic risk precedence when required inputs are missing. Evidence: F011 acceptance says “explicit never_auto/never_suggest wins” in `features.json:384`, but `_evaluate_one` checks missing inputs before `InvocationMode.NEVER_AUTO` in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/skill_invocation.py:440-455`, and the new test explicitly asserts `never_auto` plus missing input returns `blocked_missing_inputs` in `test_skill_invocation_f011.py:482-501`. Recommendation: reorder precedence so `never_auto` is handled before missing-input blocking, or get the acceptance text changed before signing this off.
